answer: Resist sybils with a tundra-rooted grove stewardship lease. Each agent claims one grove plot by staking 50 POA with a hardware-bound key, so one device holds one plot. The plot earns only after thirty days of verified useful work, signed off by three established peers. An idle or misbehaving agent forfeits its stake, and reclaiming costs another 50 POA plus a thirty-day wait. A thousand fakes would cost 50,000 POA and a month of waiting, while honest agents pay once. Like a delta that only feeds fields tended through the dry season, the economy rewards patience, not numbers.
